decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to create a powerful combo by utilizing enchantments to generate card advantage, mana, and ultimately win the game. This is achieved through cards like Argothian Enchantress, Enchantress's Presence, and Sterling Grove to draw cards and protect key pieces. The deck also includes powerful enchantments like Opalescence and Replenish to create strong board states. The goal is to set up a dominant position on the board using enchantments and overwhelm the opponent with synergy and value.

The deck focuses on assembling a combination of cards, using Tinker to find powerful artifacts like Phyrexian Devourer or Altar of Dementia. The key strategy involves generating mana quickly with cards like Mind Stone and accelerating the game with Defense Grid and Tangle Wire to protect the combo pieces. Fling is used as a finisher to deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent in one turn. Overall, the deck aims to quickly set up a lethal combo and win the game before the opponent can effectively respond.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up your graveyard with enchantments using cards like Attunement and Intuition, then using Replenish to bring back powerful enchantments like Parallax Wave and Opalescence to overwhelm your opponent. Tsabo's Web can slow down your opponent's mana development while Stifle can disrupt their key plays. The deck also includes ways to deal with opposing threats like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing. With careful planning and timing, this deck can set up powerful combos to quickly close out the game.

This deck focuses on using the Phyrexian Dreadnought's ability in combination with cards like Stifle to create a powerful combo that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a variety of counterspells and card draw options to help set up the combo and protect it from disruption. By efficiently managing resources and timing plays correctly, the deck aims to execute its game plan and secure a victory through the use of a powerful and difficult to stop combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful counter spells, removal, and board wipes to maintain board presence. It also includes the card Standstill to slow down the opponent's progress and draw more cards. The deck aims to control the pace of the game, disrupt opponent's strategy, and eventually win through incremental advantage and attrition. It also includes a win condition with Decree of Justice for creating creature tokens. The deck's key strategy is to establish a stable board state while denying opponent's threats and ultimately outlasting them in the long game.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board through discard spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, along with removal spells like Smother and Snuff Out. The deck also utilizes cards like Contamination and Contagion to keep the opponent's resources in check, while generating value with cards like Zombie Infestation and Skeletal Scrying. The deck aims to grind out the opponent through attrition, using its efficient removal and disruptive elements to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with enchantments using cards like Careful Study and Attunement, then cast Replenish to return all of those enchantments to play at once. This creates a powerful board state with cards like Opalescence turning enchantments into creatures, while also utilizing cards like Parallax Wave and Parallax Tide for additional control. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with enchantment creatures and disruption, ultimately leading to a win through a combination of powerful synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible, utilizing low-cost creatures and burn spells to get ahead early in the game. By playing efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Cursed Scroll provide additional reach and inevitability in case the game goes longer than expected.

The primary strategy of this deck is to disrupt opponents' game plans and control the board using powerful artifacts and spells. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with artifacts like Mind Stone and Thran Dynamo, while also utilizing cards like Smokestack and Tangle Wire to continuously disrupt opponent's resources. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Pyroclasm and Wildfire while also utilizing direct damage from cards like Mishra's Helix. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through resource denial and control, ultimately securing victory through attrition.

Fast and aggressive Elf tribal deck aiming to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of efficient creatures. Utilizing powerful mana acceleration and card advantage engines like Priest of Titania and Wirewood Symbiote, the deck can quickly ramp into threats like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. Survival of the Fittest provides additional flexibility and consistency by tutoring for key creatures. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Tangle Wire to slow down the opponent and finish the game with a game-winning Biorhythm or a massive creature army generated by Gaea's Cradle.

The core strategy of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Carnophage, Dauthi Slayer, and Dauthi Horror. The deck utilizes cards like Dark Ritual to power out threats early, while disruption spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy help to control the opponent's hand. The inclusion of efficient removal spells like Snuff Out and Smother provides answers to opposing threats. The deck also uses card advantage engines like Cursed Scroll and Sarcomancy to maintain pressure. Additionally, Mishra's Factory and Wasteland offer utility and additional aggression.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with hand disruption spells like Duress and Cabal Therapy, while utilizing powerful removal like Smother and Snuff Out to control the board. The deck also utilizes Contamination to lock opponents out of playing spells, and Zombie Infestation to create a steady stream of threats. With a mix of removal, hand disruption, and card advantage, this deck aims to grind out opponents and control the game until it can win with its powerful threats like Nether Spirit.

The main goal of this Mono Blue Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells, bounce spells, and card selection. By using cards like Counterspell, Force Spike, and Stifle, the deck can prevent the opponent from resolving key threats or spells. Additionally, cards like Parallax Tide and Standstill can further limit the opponent's options while setting up for a win condition like Quicksilver Dragon or Mishra's Factory. The deck also includes utility lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until it can secure a victory.

This combo deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful enchantments like Parallax Tide and Parallax Wave using cards like Attunement and Frantic Search. Once the graveyard is stocked, Replenish can bring all those enchantments back onto the battlefield, turning them into creatures with Opalescence. With the ability to control the opponent's board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Mana Leak, this deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of enchantment creatures for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on using creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Recurring Nightmare, Cabal Therapy, and Survival of the Fittest, the deck can consistently bring out key creatures and disrupt the opponent's hand. The goal is to constantly recycle creatures from the graveyard, generating value and maintaining board presence. With a mix of removal, disruption, and card advantage, the deck aims to outlast the opponent and secure victory through incremental advantages.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently use cards with the Madness and Threshold mechanics to enable aggressive plays and card advantage. By discarding cards like Arrogant Wurm and Basking Rootwalla to generate value through effects like Wild Mongrel and Circular Logic, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent while maintaining a consistent flow of resources. Other cards like Wonder and Roar of the Wurm provide additional threats and synergy with the graveyard-focused strategy, allowing for a proactive and disruptive gameplan in the Premodern 1 vs 1 format.
